newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: SECURITIES COMMISSION UNVEILS NEW RULES.
newsitem.headline: SECURITIES COMMISSION UNVEILS NEW RULES.

text.p: Lithuania's securities commission unveiled new rules on Monday which should help to make the country's equities market more transparent.
An official at the commission told Reuters that the new rules will come into force in about two weeks' time, when they will be officially published in the government's news letter.
The commission said in a statement that all firms registered with it would have to submit independent audits with their annual reports.
Lists of shareholders with stakes five percent or higher will also have to be submitted to the commission.
